title: Detailed alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Bell left -->
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='16' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <ellipse cx='22' cy='16' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#FFE29A'/>
  <rect x='18' y='22' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#E6A817'/>
  <!-- Bell right -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='16' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='16' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#FFE29A'/>
  <rect x='74' y='22' width='8' height='5' rx='2' fill='#E6A817'/>
  <!-- Hammer between bells -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='4' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='2.2' fill='#FFC38A'/>
  <!-- Top bar connecting bells -->
  <rect x='30' y='21' width='40' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#FFB627'/>
  <!-- Clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='34' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='30' fill='#FF8C8C'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='26' fill='#3A2E4D'/>
  <!-- Tick marks -->
  <g stroke='#FFE29A' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'>
    <line x1='50' y1='32' x2='50' y2='37'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='73' x2='50' y2='78'/>
    <line x1='27' y1='55' x2='32' y2='55'/>
    <line x1='68' y1='55' x2='73' y2='55'/>
    <line x1='33' y1='38' x2='36.5' y2='41.5'/>
    <line x1='63.5' y1='68.5' x2='67' y2='72'/>
    <line x1='67' y1='38' x2='63.5' y2='41.5'/>
    <line x1='36.5' y1='68.5' x2='33' y2='72'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Hour hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='50' y2='40' stroke='#FFD166' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Minute hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='64' y2='48' stroke='#FFE29A' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Second hand -->
  <line x1='50' y1='55' x2='42' y2='68' stroke='#FF8C42' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Center dot -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='3' fill='#FFD166'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='55' r='1.5' fill='#FF6B6B'/>
  <!-- Feet -->
  <rect x='32' y='86' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#E6A817'/>
  <rect x='58' y='86' width='10' height='7' rx='3' fill='#E6A817'/>
  <!-- Little shine on body -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='40' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#FFB3B3' transform='rotate(-30 38 40)'/>
</svg>
